out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Approved Record Keeping, Tags/Labels
violations.observation: Oyster shellstock tags and mussel shellstock tags were observed commingling on the same tag stabber.
violations.corrective_action: Tags/labels must be maintained in chronological order by the date recorded on the tag/label when the last shellstock is used/sold. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO SORT AND SEPARATE THE OYSTER AND MUSSEL TAGS. OYSTER TAGS AND MUSSEL TAGS WERE REORGANIZED ON TWO SEPARATE TAG STABBERS.

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Observed a small container of Raw oysters on the half shell being stored in a prep top cooler in the Simon kitchen. Container of Raw oysters did not have a shellstock tag.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. PIC DISCARDED THE RAW OYSTERS. ALL SHELLSTOCK MUST HAVE ITS ASSOCIATED SHELLSTOCK TAG WITH IT AT ALL TIMES. MAKE COPIES OF THE TAG TO KEEP WITH EACH SEPARATED GROUP OF SHELLSTOCK

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of GREEK YOGURT AND MUFFIN BATTER were observed reused for the storage of various prepared food in the main kitchen/the Simon walk-in cooler and the bakery walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DO NOT REUSE MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS (IE: YOGURT, MUFFIN BATTER, PEELED GARLIC). REPLACE WITH NSF APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
